# Description
Using genome shuffling to test for enrichment of LRR in GRBs

# Libraries
```{r Libraries, message=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(tidyverse)


project_dir <- "/home/katarina/MyProjects/targPred"
inputs_dir <- "data/inputs"
processed_dir <- "data/processed"
outputs_dir <- "/data/outputs"

source(file.path(project_dir, "src/scripts/utils.R"))
```

Load data
```{r}
ep_permutated <- read.table(file.path(project_dir, "data", "random", "shuffled_beds", "out_7357.txt"))
```


## Shuffled grbs
```{r}
x <- ep_permutated$V1

ggplot(data = data.frame(x), aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), bins = 100,  fill="gray", color="black") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, fill="red", color="black") +
  labs(title="Histogram with Density Overlay", x="x", y="Density") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 241863, linetype="dotted", color = "blue", size=1.5) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
x <- ep_permutated$V2

options(scipen = 999)
ggplot(data = data.frame(x), aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), bins = 100,  fill="gray", color="black") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, fill="yellow", color="black") +
  labs(title="Histogram with Density Overlay", x="x", y="Density") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 108324, linetype="dotted", color = "blue", size=1.5) +
  theme_bw()
```




# Ignore this
```{r}
enhancer_transcript_df <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "by_GRB_list_enh_trans_df.rds"))
```

Distribution of EP lenghts 
```{r}
data_ <- enhancer_transcript_df %>%
  filter(emp < 0.001 & !is.na(enh_trans_range)) %>% 
  select(enh, transcript, enh_trans_range) %>%
  unique()

x <- data_$enh_trans_range

ggplot(data = data.frame(x), aes(x = log10(x))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),  fill="gray", color="black") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, fill="orange", color="black") +
  labs(title="Histogram EP lenghts in GRBs", x="x", y="Density") +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
data_ <- enhancer_transcript_df %>%
  select(grb) %>%
  unique()

grbs <- grangesFromDataframe(data = data_, colName = grb)
makeBed(grbs, modify_start = -1, filename = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "genome_browser", "modified_grbs_overlaping_enh_and_loci2021.bed"))

summary(width(grbs))

x <- width(grbs)

ggplot(data = data.frame(x), aes(x = log10(x))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),  fill="gray", color="black") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, fill="violet", color="black") +
  labs(title="Histogram GRB width", x="x", y="Density") +
  theme_bw()
```


Mean and median EP legnth grb
```{r}
data_ <- enhancer_transcript_df %>%
  filter(emp < 0.001 & !is.na(enh_trans_range)) %>% 
  select(enh, transcript, enh_trans_range) %>%
  unique()


grb_mean <- mean(data_$enh_trans_range)
grb_median <- median(data_$enh_trans_range)
```
